summary: Cronin Mountain lookout in the Bulkley-Nechako area of BC, near Smithers: a 2026 guide lists it as likely standing; no build, staffing or fire history found.

facts.status_note: A 2026 guide lists it among lookouts confirmed or likely to have standing structures.

notes_for_editor: Confidence is low. The Canada Lookouts entry gives only a coordinate block, and the 2026 guide only lists the tower as likely standing. The record's coordinates (54.93517, -126.78424) differ from Canada Lookouts (54.935, -126.77) by about 1 km in longitude, which the rounding of the Canada Lookouts figure can account for; the record was not changed. The link between the Canada Lookouts 'Cronin' entry and the Smithers lookout is inferred from the shared name and district, not stated by a source. A Facebook group post in search results mentions an old lookout near Mt. Cronin built in 1953, but the post body could not be read (fetch_text and WebFetch returned only the title), so that date is not used. The Firelookout.ca page renders no lookout fields. No build date, staffing, fire history, access level, design or photos are recorded.
